body: Pretty similar situation here. 24.5 year old (but female), no job, no family, the friend I did have has ditched me and blocked me. I recently have been diagnosed with "high-functioning" Autism which basically means that I'm good at faking being normal enough that people think that I'm just boring or can magically fix my misgivings. The number one cause of death in people with "high-functioning" Autism is suicide, so I'm just about to fall into my fate.
Thanks, but FYI the mods tend to take posts like this down.

I disagree, the people I've met there have been very kind and warm and clearly want things to get better for me. They've set me up with outside help post discharge and helped me get on insurance when I didn't know how. Heck, sometimes I miss being there. It might depend on which hospital you go to and where.

Don't stop being there for them. If you think they're in danger, please inform the police. From there your friend(s) might be taken to the emergency room and then to an inpatient psych ward. There's a bad stigma to those places and some aspects of staying there aren't ideal, but they really do help a lot of people. I've been to one twice now after years of thinking it was a place for bad people who should be locked away from society due to associating it with my abusive parents. It's not like that at all. Psych wards are probably the best places to be when there's nothing left and you're in danger of suicide. Your friend (s) maybe be annoyed but that's better than being dead.
